cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women between 20 and 40 weeks of gestation who reported decreased fetal movement and had a small estimated placental volume (below the 10th percentile for gestational age).
finding: Small estimated placental volume is significantly associated with decreased fetal movement and adverse pregnancy outcomes, such as fetal growth restriction and preterm birth.
gest_age: 20 to 40 weeks of gestation (inclusion criteria), 36.8 +/- 2.3 weeks at delivery
